correctness.rationale: For every finite thick GQ(s,t), incidence axioms yield girth eight, diameter four and the exact distance-two/three adjacency classification. Unique common neighbors justify every radius-two free-face pair, giving a relative collapse to G. Each radius-three clique factor collapses by free faces to a connected graph with b=(st)^2 loops, and their join is a wedge of b^2 three-spheres. Integral barcode endpoints follow from relative collapse, homological dimensions and radius-four contractibility. Standard-library independent finite tests check W(2), W(3) and concrete collapses; finite tests are not the proof.
